DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Urinary Retention with associated Uterine Atony.
The combination of an 11-pound baby, prolonged labor, decreased bowel sounds, and specific reports of urinary frequency and uterine tenderness strongly suggests the bladder is distended, preventing the uterus from contracting properly. I will now confirm these findings with a physical exam.
